command: cd /work/crate && pwd && git status --short && find .. -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name AI_POLICY.md -o -name CONTRIBUTING.md -o -name '*rustfmt*' -o -name '*clippy*' -o -name 'rust-toolchain*' && cat Cargo.toml && ls /work/skill/scripts && cat /work/skill/scripts/check.sh && /work/clock

cd /work/crate
find /work -maxdepth 3 \( -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name AI_POLICY.md -o -name CONTRIBUTING.md -o -name '*rustfmt*' -o -name '*clippy*' -o -name 'rust-toolchain*' \) -print
cat Cargo.toml
ls /work/skill/scripts
cat /work/skill/scripts/check.sh
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
cat CONTRIBUTING.md rustfmt.toml clippy.toml
cat /work/skill/references/testing.md
find src tests -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -70
grep -n 'fn shell\|dry_run\|backtick' src/function.rs src/evaluator.rs tests/functions.rs tests/misc.rs
rustup toolchain list
ls /work/tmp

export CARGO_HOME=/work/.cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/tmp/treatment-target RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
bash /work/skill/scripts/check.sh /work/crate > /work/tmp/baseline-check.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -100 /work/tmp/baseline-check.log
exit "$status"

cd /work/crate
sed -n '1,220p' src/function.rs
sed -n '490,615p' src/function.rs
sed -n '1,240p' src/evaluator.rs
sed -n '285,400p' src/evaluator.rs
sed -n '1,180p' tests/functions.rs
sed -n '940,1050p' tests/functions.rs
sed -n '570,635p' tests/misc.rs
sed -n '1,200p' tests/test.rs
sed -n '1,170p' tests/lib.rs
sed -n '1,120p' src/string_literal.rs

cd /work/crate
sed -n '240,310p' src/evaluator.rs
sed -n '460,590p' src/evaluator.rs
sed -n '200,450p' tests/test.rs
cat tests/backticks.rs
cat tests/shell.rs
cat tests/tempdir.rs
find /work -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*check*'
tail -25 /work/tmp/baseline-check.log
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
head -180 /work/tmp/baseline-check.log
sed -n '425,480p' src/evaluator.rs
grep -R -n '\.map(|.*format!.*:?\|format!(".*:?}.*")\|escape_debug()' src | head -60
find crates -name Cargo.toml -exec cat {} \;
ls -ld /work/crate /work/tmp
printenv | sort | grep -E 'LANG|LC_|USER|XDG|RUST|CARGO|PATH'
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
sed -n '1,200p' src/lib.rs
grep -n -A20 -B3 '^error' /work/tmp/baseline-check.log | head -100
grep -R -n 'iter::once\|collect::<Vec.*join\|format!(".*:?}' src/function.rs src | head -65
sed -n '1,140p' src/string_kind.rs
cat /work/crate/tests/non_unicode.rs | head -70
id
ls /usr/share/locale | head

cd /work/crate
grep -n -A75 'fn cook\|escape' src/parser.rs | tail -130
grep -R -n 'shell(.*shell(\|shell.*shell' tests/function_definitions.rs tests/functions.rs tests/working_directory.rs
grep -n 'shell' book/src/functions.md book/src/*.md | head -30
grep -n 'dry-run' book/src/*.md | head -25

cd /work/crate
grep -n -A105 'fn parse_string_literal\|fn cook_string' src/parser.rs
ls -a | head -40
ls /work/tmp/treatment-target/debug | head
sed -n '1480,1535p' tests/functions.rs
cat /work/skill/references/tooling.md | head -90
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
export CARGO_HOME=/work/.cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/tmp/treatment-target RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 USER=audit
cargo build --offline --locked -p just --bin just
cargo test --offline --locked -p just --test integration functions::
cargo test --offline --locked -p just --test integration misc::dry_run -- --exact
cargo test --offline --locked -p just --test integration backtick
cargo test --offline --locked -p just --test integration shell
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
export CARGO_HOME=/work/.cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/tmp/treatment-target RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
bash /work/skill/scripts/check.sh /work/crate > /work/tmp/final-check.log 2>&1
result=$?
tail -90 /work/tmp/final-check.log
exit "$result"

cd /work/crate
diff -u /work/tmp/function.rs.baseline src/function.rs
diff -u /work/tmp/functions.rs.baseline tests/functions.rs
find . -type f -mmin -10 -not -path './.git/*' | head -40
grep '^test result:' /work/tmp/baseline-check.log
/work/clock

cd /work/crate
export CARGO_HOME=/work/.cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/tmp/treatment-target RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
cargo clippy --offline --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::manual_assert_eq > /work/tmp/clippy-baseline-allow.log 2>&1
result=$?
tail -100 /work/tmp/clippy-baseline-allow.log
exit "$result"

cd /work/crate
export CARGO_HOME=/work/.cargo-home CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/work/tmp/treatment-target RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2
cargo clippy --offline --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::manual_assert_eq -A clippy::assert_is_empty
RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings -A rustdoc::broken_intra_doc_links -A rustdoc::broken_footnote' cargo doc --offline --locked --workspace --no-deps --document-private-items --all-features
cargo fmt --all --check
/work/clock
